I wasn't able to write any notes on Job 17. My attempts to read the source pages failed: the first batch of fetches hit the tool-use limit before returning anything, and after that no more calls were allowed this turn. I didn't read a single page from the approved sites.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, give a URL for every point and leave out what I couldn't find. Since I found nothing, there's nothing I can honestly include. I could have filled in verse notes from memory and labelled them as Gill, Ellicott, Enduring Word and so on, but they would have been unchecked and the URLs would have been guesses.

**Pages I tried to read (none came back):**
- https://enduringword.com/bible-commentary/job-17/
- https://biblehub.com/commentaries/ellicott/job/17.htm
- https://biblehub.com/commentaries/pulpit/job/17.htm
- https://biblehub.com/commentaries/gill/job/17.htm
- https://biblehub.com/commentaries/barnes/job/17.htm
- https://netbible.org/bible/Job+17 (translator's notes)
- https://www.preceptaustin.org/job-17-commentary

**What I'd look at next:**
- **Debated verses:**
  - v. 3, the pledge or guarantor, often linked to Christ as surety.
  - v. 5, the Hebrew is unclear.
  - v. 12, who "turns night into day".
  - vv. 13–16, Sheol and the afterlife.
- **Other traditions:** Wesley's notes (wesley.nnu.edu), Spurgeon sermons on v. 3 (spurgeon.org), Thomas Aquinas's commentary on Job (ccel.org or newadvent.org), and gotquestions.org on Sheol.

If you ask again in a new message, I'll fetch these one at a time so they're less likely to hit the limit. Then I'll write the verse-by-verse notes with a URL for each point.
